newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP SETS MAXIMUM ONE-DAY REVREPO RATE AT 21.30 PCT.
newsitem.headline: NBP SETS MAXIMUM ONE-DAY REVREPO RATE AT 21.30 PCT.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland set a maximum one-day reverse repo rate at 21.30 percent against the last 14-day drainage maximum rate of 19.16, the bank said.
The NBP said it drained 21 million zlotys from the market through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 113 million against the central bank's 300 million zloty offer.
The average accepted rate was also 21.30 percent.
